suggestions.reason: At 1695 chars this exceeds the limit by roughly 40%. Every run in both arms exceeds 1200 chars; combined with the other content requirements (assumption, artifact request, stop-statement, one question), the threshold looks tighter than the task realistically allows.

eval_feedback.overall: Content assertions are well-grounded; the character-count ceiling looks miscalibrated.
